reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for multi-round code review, issue triage, bounded fixes, validation, rollback, and convergence tracking, with a read-only dry-run mode and supporting UI panels.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中执行多轮代码审查、问题分流、受限修复与验证回滚，并提供只读审查和迭代进度面板。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for multi-round code review, issue triage, bounded fixes, validation and rollback, with read-only review and iteration progress panels.

capabilities: Reviews project code across configured dimensions
Reads project configuration, context, history, diffs, and iteration state
Applies bounded atomic file fixes in normal mode
Runs whitelisted validation commands after fixes
Rolls back failed fixes and records logs, checkpoints, and runtime artifacts
Provides triage, convergence, statistics, status, and configuration UI panels
